xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2652: Conversation view diverges from Terminal: Claude Code backgrounding forks the session file in-process, invisible to all session-id resolution paths

plan.title: Conversation view diverges from Terminal: Claude Code backgrounding forks the session file in-process, invisible to all session-id resolution paths
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One bug with five coupled failure points: the read/write door, one precedence helper routed through four pin-first sites, adoption, and stream follow. Shipping any subset leaves the Conversation and Terminal views disagreeing in a new way (e.g. a real write door without native-compact restart or stream follow). 24 files, mostly tests.

narratives.Problem: Claude Code can move a running conversation to a new session file in-process (backgrounding a turn copies the history into a new session id). The launcher pin, the oldest-locator read door, the /clear-only orphan scanner and the agents-only live-id lookup all keep the old id, and the write door setConversationClaudeSessionId is a no-op under oldest-wins. The Conversation tab freezes while the Terminal advances; resume returns to the stale session; delivery receipts and cost ledger miss the fork.
narratives.Proposal: Make the newest conversation_files locator the conversation's current session and make the write door re-point it (with a change notification). Route the four pin-first sites through one helper (human head: locator then pin; superseded /clear row: own locator; agents unchanged). Adopt forks in the 10 s lifecycle poll from the session index and from the backgrounding marker, both behind a shared-uuid lineage check. Let the open transcript stream switch files on the notification with a reset snapshot. Keep teardown matching the launched id, and restart the runtime on the fork after native /compact.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing #2672's 'parent never stays ended' reconciler bug or its DB split-brain claim
- Changing session resolution for agent conversations (agent-, planning-, specialist-)
- Changing any non-Claude harness resolver (Pi, Codex, ACP, Kimi, Muse, Prime)
- Rewriting launcher.sh for a live process; the next resume regenerates it
- Live session switching for Shared Sessions viewers
- Changing the origin-locator listing queries (sessions feed, archive, title search, batch lookup)
- Any frontend change; following happens server-side on the existing subscription
- Distinguishing an in-process fork from an outside 'claude --resume --fork-session' run whose session lands in the same session index
- Adding a unique index or migration to conversation_files

autoDecisions.summary: Lineage is matched on entry uuids copied into the fork (first 20 head uuids; the backgrounding uuid for the marker path), not on the first user-message uuid
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue comment (same author, later) corrects the body: a real fork on 2026-08-18 copied only part of the history; verified on this machine (myn 091805a1 -> 37d23b52, 1,536 of 12,384 entries copied, bg uuid shared).

autoDecisions.summary: Ship both candidate sources (session index and backgrounding marker) instead of gating the marker scan on a manual reproduction checkpoint
autoDecisions.rationale: Hook recording of the fork id is unverified (no managed fork exists on this machine), the marker path is cheap and bounded, and an interactive reproduction is not reliable for a work agent.

autoDecisions.summary: Every adoption candidate must pass a shared-uuid lineage check
autoDecisions.rationale: conv-20260920-d73c's sessions.json contains sessions of other Claude processes in the same terminal session; the post-/clear session is also recorded there; lineage rejects both.

autoDecisions.summary: Native /compact restarts the runtime on the compacted fork
autoDecisions.rationale: Once the write door is real the native-compact locator would otherwise make the view diverge from the live process, recreating this bug class.

autoDecisions.summary: The write door upserts instead of inserting duplicates
autoDecisions.rationale: conversation_files has no unique index and the cost ledger sums every matching row, so duplicates double-count cost.

autoDecisions.summary: The open stream follows via an in-process notifier fired by the write door, not a new event-store event
autoDecisions.rationale: Adoption and the stream run in the same dashboard process; no wire-contract change and no frontend change are needed.
